# system-explorer

> Last-checked: 2026-08-10

Purpose: map desired system functions to evidenced function carriers.
Truth boundary: source systems remain authoritative; evidence is referenced.
Safety boundary: proposals are read-only and never authorize target mutation.
Key command: system-explorer --help
Verification baseline: 154 Pytest unit tests and 26 subtests, 154 unittest cases, Ruff, compileall, CLI help, manifest validation, and `doc-lint` passed locally after the external-authority bundle on 2026-08-13. No provider, swarm runner, credential or mirror action was performed.
Architecture: ARCHITECTURE.md
Evidence rules: docs/EVIDENCE-MODEL.md
Data and cloud rules: docs/DATA-CLOUD-MODEL.md
Deployment and purpose rules: docs/DEPLOYMENT-PURPOSE-MODEL.md
Federated map contract: docs/FEDERATED-MAPS.md
Time-bound provider baseline: docs/CLOUD-SERVER-BASELINE_2026-07-29.md
Crystallized software resources: docs/CRYSTALLIZED-RESOURCES.md
Connector contracts: docs/CONNECTOR-ADAPTERS.md
Portable map: system-explorer map-export --config <config> --view all --output <map.json>
Cross-system analysis: system-explorer map --config <config> --view <view> [--system <id>]
Explainer handoff: system-explorer explain-video --config <config> --output <dir> --media-editor <repo>
Repository diagrams: system-explorer diagrams --repo <repo> [--apply --commit --push]
